additional_info.subject: RE: 0483109 - ID0483109-DC/Si-D/CL-[MP / R7 170002131] Curauma- SID DC4 Error CRM:00472000586
additional_info.body:
Hello Jesus,
I have thoroughly reviewed the session diagram and the charging process and the Logs. The beginning of the charging session shows the full capacity of 300 kW being reached successfully. The first-come, first-serve rule is respected so second EV gets less power, after the first EV disconnects, the power
does
increase for the second vehicle from around 80 kW up to 160 kW, indicating normal behaviour. Also through the session the charger is always matching the requested power from the EV.
Regarding the logs, there was a moment when contactors QA21 and QA22 appeared to be stuck, but they got released shortly afterward.
Therefore, I do not see any ongoing issue related to this in the logs.
If you need further information or if anything is unclear, please reach out, otherwise I would close the ticket.
Regards,
eMobility Support Queue Tobias Wieser
